_comment: WO-OR-22 fixture — a comment with dispositions but NO `@tower head:` directive. Fully static (no substitution). Ingest must REFUSE it: a comment that does not state the head it was written against cannot be bound to one, and binding it to a head the author never saw is exactly the defect this seam prevents.
